channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Scottie Scheffler frustrated and over par in Round 1 of WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Coming off a win in his first start of the season, Scheffler showed a lot of negative emotion in a 2-over 73 in Round 1 of the WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: Chamblee: Koepka -- and everyone! -- should use a mallet putter
item.description: Brooks Koepka is switching from a blade to a mallet putter at the WM Phoenix Open. On "Golf Central Pregame," Brandel Chamblee says all players -- professional and amateurs -- benefit from using the more forgiving putter.

item.title: Gotterup: 'Conservative' play key to Round 1 success
item.description: Chris Gotterup talked with Golf Channel's Ryan Lavner after his first round at the WM Phoenix Open. Gotterup, who missed the previous two cuts at TPC Scottsdale, is the clubhouse leader after shooting a 63 Thursday.

item.title: Scheffler struggles with short game at TPC Scottsdale
item.description: Scottie Scheffler tied his highest-scoring round since the start of the 2025 season, finishing with a 2-over 73 at TPC Scottsdale on Thursday. The two-time WM Phoenix Open winner was visibly frustrated going through his first round and currently sits outside the cutline. Scheffler was last cut at the 2022 FedEx St. Jude Championship.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open 2026: Second-round tee times, groupings, how to watch
item.description: Tee times, groupings and how to watch the second round of the WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: Football helmet on the golf course? Joel Dahmen shows Seahawks pride at WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Joel Dahmen gave the "People's Open" a new spin rocking a Seattle Seahawks helmet on the 16th hole before removing to chip in for birdie to the crowd's amazement. Dahmen, a Washington state native, predicted the Seahawks will win Super Bowl LX by two touchdowns Sunday.

item.title: Chris Gotterup fires 63 alongside Scottie Scheffler, who struggles to 73 at WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Playing in the same group, Gotterup was 10 shots better than the world No. 1 on Thursday at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: WM's '12th man' goes nuts for Seahawks fan Dahmen
item.description: Washington state native Joel Dahmen repped his NFC champion Seattle Seahawks on the par-3 16th Thursday at the 2026 WM Phoenix Open, and then chipped in to set off the crowd.

item.title: Koepka switches from blade to mallet putter in Phoenix
item.description: Brooks Koepka switched from a blade putter to a mallet putter ahead of the WM Phoenix Open in hopes it would help improve his struggles on the greens. Koepka finished with a 4-over 75 during the first round at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: WM Phoenix Open, Round 1
item.description: Scottie Scheffler struggled at TPC Scottsdale on Thursday and Chris Gotterup took advantage of an early start times to lay claim to the leaderboard. In the afternoon, Hideki Matsuyama, Joel Dahmen and Keith Mitchell shined. The famous 16th hole "Coliseum" saw plenty of birdie putts, and an incredible chip-in from Dahmen.
